blocks.text: Prokaryotes mein nucleus nahin hota aur transcription cytoplasm mein hoti hai, is liye un ke naye mRNA ko translation shuru karne ke liye kahin jana nahin parta. Eukaryotic cells mein naye mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm tak safar karna hota hai. Is safar ke liye naye mRNA mein yeh tabdeeliyan ki jati hain:

1- 5′ cap lagana: mRNA ka pehla nucleotide (5′ sire par) A ya G hota hai. Is A ya G ke 5′ sire par aik methylated GTP jor diya jata hai; yeh bond A ya G ke 5′ sire aur GTP ke 5′ sire ke darmiyan banta hai. Is structure ko 5′ cap kehte hain. Yeh safar ke dauran mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases (RNA torne wale enzymes) se bachata hai.

2- 3′ poly-A tail lagana: mRNA ke 3′ sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides ki chhoti zanjeer jor di jati hai jise 3′ poly-A tail kehte hain. Yeh mRNA ko nucleases se tootne (degradation) se bachati hai.

blocks.alt: Template DNA 3' se 5': promoter aur chaar exons jin ke beech teen introns. Transcription se immature mRNA (5' se 3'); 5' cap (GTP) aur 3' poly-A dum (AAAA) ka izafa; mRNA splicing introns nikal kar mature mRNA deti hai: 5' cap, protein-coding sequence, 3' poly-A dum, cytoplasm jane ke liye tayyar. Qaus (bracket) transcription ke baad ke qadmon ko post-transcriptional modifications dikhata hai.

blocks.text: 3- Splicing: naya mRNA kaccha (immature) hota hai kyun ke us mein introns (DNA ya mRNA ke woh hisse jo protein ka code nahin dete) aur exons (woh hisse jo "express" ho kar protein mein translate hote hain) dono hote hain. mRNA splicing woh amal hai jis mein immature mRNA se introns nikal diye jate hain aur baqi exons aapas mein jor diye jate hain. Is tarah pukhta (mature) mRNA mein sirf coding hisse (gene) rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Eukaryotic mRNA ko 5′ cap aur poly-A tail ki zaroorat kyun hai, prokaryotic mRNA ko kyun nahin?
blocks.explanation: Eukaryotic mRNA ko nucleus se cytoplasm tak jana hota hai; cap aur tail raaste mein use nucleases jaise enzymes se bachate hain. Prokaryotic mRNA cytoplasm hi mein banta hai aur foran translate ho jata hai.

items: Initiation: RNA polymerase (σ subunit) promoter se jurta hai; primer nahin chahiye.
Elongation: transcription bubble mein rNTPs se RNA 5′ se 3′ banta hai.
Termination: GC hairpin + U wali tail se RNA alag ho jata hai.
Eukaryotes: 5′ cap, 3′ poly-A tail aur introns ki splicing.
